item.title: v5.14.2
item.description:
• Fix: Version 0.14.0 introduced a regression due to a security headers update, which prevented downloading generated documents inside an iframe. This has been fixed.
• Fix: HEAD /render/:renderId is now allowed without authentication, like GET /render/:renderId . A HEAD used to return 401 when authentication was on.

item.title: v5.14.1
item.description:
• [EE] Fix: :set() with a relative path (e.g. {d.obj.val:set(.flag)} ) no longer crashes when the parent object is missing from the data. The value is left unset, the same way a marker naming missing data prints nothing.
• [EE] Fix: batchReportName is now respected even when the ZIP contains only one file.
• Carbone ICE (Instant Converter Engine): now correctly handles line breaks.

item.title: v5.14.0
item.description:
• Upgraded all dependencies and switched from Node 22 to Node 24
• â¡ï¸ New converter: Carbone ICE (Instant Converter Engine) . It reads a DOCX and converts it to PDF directly within Carbone, without relying on LibreOffice, OnlyOffice, Chrome or any other program on the machine. There is no office suite to install, no external process to start, watch or restart, and no temporary file written between the report generation and its conversion. Up to 60x faster than LibreOffice on a 1000-page DOCX, and 3x faster on a one-page document. The bigger the document, the wider the gap: a large report no longer pays the fixed cost of an office suite loading it, laying it out and printing it. When the job balancer is off, the document is handed directly from the render process to the converter in memory. On a 150-page report, this reduces the handover time to 30 ms instead of 345 ms. How to use it : pass "converter": "I" in the options of POST /render , next to the existing "L" (LibreOffice), "O" (OnlyOffice) and "C" (Chrome). In the Studio, pick "Carbone ICE (docx to pdf)" in the document converter panel of the preview. The converter is enabled and available by default. It can be disabled by setting carboneIcePath (environment variable CARBONE_CARBONE_ICE_PATH ) to an empty string. Multi-threaded : Carbone ICE converts multiple documents in parallel, controlled by the factories setting ( CARBONE_FACTORIES ). Each factory runs as a worker thread. Scope for this first release: DOCX to PDF conversion only. Support for more formats coming soon. Pages/sections: Handles page size/orientation, section margins, headers, footers, mixed portrait/landscape, page/section breaks, text columns. Headers/footers: Different headers/footers for first, odd/even pages, per section. Calculates PAGE , NUMPAGES , SECTIONPAGES . Paragraphs: Supports all paragraph styles, alignment (left/center/right/justified), indentation, spacing, line spacing, tab stops, borders, shading, widow/orphan… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-14-0)

item.title: v5.13.1
item.description:
• â ï¸ Chrome converter Only (HTML to PDF) : Fixed a rare issue where PDFs could mix content from different reports if several were generated at the same time. Now, each PDF always contains the correct data. No more blocked or mixed documents if a download is cancelled or the connection is lost during PDF creation. Errors or interruptions for one PDF can no longer affect another.
• [EE] Hardened the job balancer (only when CARBONE_JOB_BALANCER=true) with improved cluster-wide ID safety to prevent collisions. Cancelled or interrupted reports are now safely re-queued and are never lost or duplicated. This improvement is independent of the Chrome issue above and was made at the same time as a comprehensive review of the job system's robustness.

item.title: v5.13.0
item.description:
• Chrome converter improvements: Reverted the changes in 5.12.0 regarding the maximum message size between Carbone and Chrome. Chrome enforces a built-in 100MB limit on messages (input HTML, or generated PDF), regardless of what Carbone sets for its WebSocket. The Carbone-defined limit is therefore removed. When the Chrome limit is reached, Carbone now swiftly restores communication, ensuring stability. Carbone forces Chrome to exit after 5 seconds if it cannot shut down properly, preventing an infinite wait.
• Added the ability to disable detection of missing i+1 tag in v5 when a pre-release tag ( preReleaseFeatureIn ) is set to a value lower than 5000000 in the template, API, or global configuration ( CARBONE_PRE_RELEASE_FEATURE_IN ). This can force Carbone v5 to behave like Carbone v4, helping you migrate to production without fixing legacy templates that contain syntax errors but previously worked in v4. Only features and fixes introduced up to the specified tag are enabled. Any introduced in a higher tag are disabled.
• Multiple improvements to PDF operations when generating PDFs with Chrome and OnlyOffice converters: Default encryption is now AES-256 instead of the deprecated 128-bit encryption. Password protection now encrypts document properties (Title, Author, Subject, and other Info strings). Encryption performance improved by a factor of 5.
• Appending, merging, and adding multiple watermarks to PDFs is now at least twice as fast.
• Studio improvements studio.setConfig({ defaultDataPanel : 'editor' }) selects the panel shown at startup in the data editor: 'editor' for the raw JSON editor (default), 'viewer' for the simplified JSON viewer, where clicking a property inserts the corresponding Carbone tag. The user can still switch panels with the two buttons of the data editor. Accept more template origins: Salesforce (origin = 2), Odoo (3), HubSpot (4). For reference: 0 = API, 1 = Studio.
• [EE] Markdown templates now support dynamic… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-13-0)

item.title: v5.12.0
item.description:
• Improved logging: Suppressed unnecessary error messages during routine cleanup of the template/render directories when files are already deleted or removed due to race conditions.
• [EE] Cluster peer connections ( peerPort / peerEndpoints ) are now more reliable, key improvements: A periodic supervisor: Recreates the WebSocket server if it crashes or the port becomes unavailable ( EADDRINUSE ). Re-resolves peerEndpoints via DNS, so peers with changed IPs (e.g. during Kubernetes rolling updates) are rediscovered. Reconnects to any missing peer endpoint. Cleans up dead connections using a liveness timer when a connection opens, preventing rare deadlocks that could occur in previous versions and ensuring automatic connection recovery without requiring a restart. New exposed parameter peerCheckInterval (or CARBONE_PEER_CHECK_INTERVAL , default 10s): period of the peer liveness ping. The supervisor runs twice as often (half this value) so a lost peer is re-dialed faster than it is detected. Connections establish more reliably, no matter which peer initiates Supervisor uses exponential backoff: starts at half peerCheckInterval , increases up to 1 minute, and resets to fast on important events (startup, server restart, peer connect/disconnect). Peer DNS resolution is fault-tolerant: if a peer name cannot be resolved (e.g. missing DNS during a rolling update), other available peers still connect; the whole cluster isn't skipped. Maximum WebSocket message size for cluster peer connections now uses the existing maxDataSize ( CARBONE_MAX_DATA_SIZE ) parameter. By consequence, the default changed from 100MB to 60MB. Improved Event-bus logs: cluster events show peer count and addresses resolved by DNS resolution (only when changed). Unreachable peers are logged with the next retry delay (e.g. cannot reach peer ... - retrying in Xs ) at every attempt, so network issues are visible without enabling debug logs. Remaining low-level socket errors are shown only at debug… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-12-0)

item.title: v5.11.0
v5.10.0-beta
item.description:
• [EE] The job balancer now also distributes asynchronous rendering jobs ( POST /render with a webhook). When enabled, both job types (document conversions and asynchronous document generations) can be offloaded to other peers that have available resources.
• Asynchronous jobs are now stored on disk in a compressed format, reducing disk usage and speeding up job transfers between peers.

item.title: v5.9.2
item.description: • Improved logs when the job balancer is used, making it easier to distinguish between external requests and internal job distribution.

item.title: v5.9.1
item.description:
• [EE] Added a job balancer (Beta) that spreads document conversion load across the peers of a cluster. When a peer is idle and another peer is overloaded, the idle peer automatically "steals" pending conversion jobs from the busy peer, runs them locally, and sends the result back. This smooths out conversion spikes without any external load balancer. Disabled by default. Enable it with the jobBalancer parameter (env var CARBONE_JOB_BALANCER=true ). It only works when the internal cluster channel is enabled, i.e. when peerPort is set (and peers are reachable through peerEndpoints ). If peerPort is not defined, the job balancer stays inactive even when jobBalancer is true . How it works: each peer periodically broadcasts the size of its conversion queue to the other peers. A peer that has free conversion factories pulls jobs from the most overloaded peer (pull-based model, so newly started peers naturally take their share and slow peers take fewer jobs). Aborted jobs and timeouts are propagated to the remote peer, and a peer stops stealing new jobs as soon as it begins a graceful shutdown. â ï¸ Like the rest of the cluster channel, this internal traffic is not authenticated or encrypted : use it only inside a secure private network.
• [EE] The OpenMetrics /metrics endpoint now exposes a new gauge carbone_reports_inflight{stage="conversion"} reporting the number of document conversion jobs currently waiting in the queue.

item.title: v5.9.0
item.description:
• If data is undefined when calling POST /render , Carbone only converts the file and skips the entire templating process. As a result, tags remain unchanged in the converted document.
• Added support for the custom header carbone-egress-header-authorization to customize the authorization header for egress traffic, such as webhooks, images, and external PDF URLs. For example, if carbone-egress-header-authorization: my-secret is included during report generation, the header authorization: my-secret will be added when Carbone calls a webhook, an external image URL, an external PDF URL, etc. If carbone-webhook-header-authorization is used at the same time, it overrides carbone-egress-header-authorization for webhook calls only. Only the authorization header can be customized, and its value must not exceed 512 characters.
• Studio: General UX improvements: Rename the "Stop Auto-Upload" button to the less technical "Finish Editing" . Improve filename readability for long filenames by displaying as much of the name as possible while always keeping the end of the filename visible (use an ellipsis in the middle). Clearly indicate that the Studio is listening for file changes with a subtle, low-resource animated icon. Clearly show how long ago the file was updated and when the latest changes were synchronized and taken into account by the Studio. Add a Docs button with an enriched menu. Fix the Profile button on Safari. Improve text search in the JSON editor with Next and Previous buttons, a result counter, and the current search position. If more than 200 occurrences are found, the UI stops counting them to avoid performance issues with very large JSON files.

item.title: v5.8.0
item.description:
• [Studio] Fix the drop-down list bug and the recent list issue in Safari.
• [On-Premise only] In Markdown templates, the special tag {o.styleSource = templateOrVersionId} allows applying the style from another DOCX or ODT template. The style template can include Carbone tags. Styles such as headings, tables, headers, and footers are applied only when converting Markdown to DOCX, ODT, or PDF.
• [EE] PDFs generated with Chrome and OnlyOffice converters now support full encryption and security options, matching LibreOffice. All PDF security features are supported: EncryptFile (boolean): Enable PDF encryption (requires password). DocumentOpenPassword (string): Password required to open the PDF. RestrictPermissions (boolean): Restrict actions like printing, copying, and editing (requires PermissionPassword ). PermissionPassword (string): Password to set/change permissions. Changes (integer): Control what edits are allowed (0: none, 1: pages, 2: forms, 3: comments/forms, 4: all except extraction). EnableCopyingOfContent (boolean): Allow content copying. EnableTextAccessForAccessibilityTools (boolean): Allow access for accessibility tools. Printing (integer): Allow printing (0: none, 1: low-res, 2: high-res).
• Increased the allowed memory allocation to 8 GB to support large XLSX reports.

item.title: v5.7.0
item.description:
• [Studio] Small UI fixes and update BeerCSS to v4.0.21 (Material Design M3) Template list: remove empty items from category/tag filters The selected item in the list is now visible only after pressing a keyboard arrow key to avoid confusion with mouse hover Replace HTML main tags with div elements to keep a single global main element and avoid bugs with the new BeerCSS Harmonize margins and button styles Use the new split buttons Improve table responsiveness
• Accept equality filters that do not strictly match types in array search expressions ( lookup ), added in v5.2.0. For example: table[rank=3] matches both rank = 3 and rank = '3' . This change aligns the behavior with the historical behavior of array filters.

item.title: v5.6.1
item.description:
• [On-Premise] Added the global parameter maxDownloadFileTimeout ( CARBONE_MAX_DOWNLOAD_FILE_TIMEOUT ) to configure the default timeout (6 seconds) for downloading images or files from URLs or when using appendTemplate (which behaves similarly by downloading a file from another Carbone instance).
• [On-Premise] Added the global boolean parameter pdfPostCompression ( CARBONE_PDF_POST_COMPRESSION , default: false), which can reduce PDF size by up to 3x when merging PDFs using :appendTemplate , :appendFile , or during batch processing to a single PDF output.
• [EE] Fix: PDF templates that use annotations with Carbone tags to update forms are now cleanly removed from the result PDF.
• [EE] PDFs generated with Chrome converter can now be encrypted using the same options as LibreOffice. Example: { "convertTo": { "formatName": "pdf", "formatOptions": { "EncryptFile": true, "DocumentOpenPassword": "QWERTY1234" } } }
• [EE] Fix: Timeout when downloading images or files from URLs when using batch processing no longer causes a crash.
• [On-Premise] Improve logs at startup (number of factories , show if options pdfPostCompression or nbReportMaxPerBatch are activated)

item.title: v5.6.0
item.description:
• [EE] The :autoOrient formatter can be used to automatically rotate an image according to the camera or smartphone orientation. It is supported only in DOCX templates. It can be used with imageFit(contain) or imageFit(fillWidth) , but not with imageFit(fill) . It only works with JPEG images. Other image formats ignore this formatter. To reduce processing as much as possible, the orientation is applied directly in the template (no JPEG processing).
• Fix: Accepts whitespace before the :color formatter.
• [EE] The :color(scope, type) formatter is supported in PPTX templates for all combinations of type (background, text, border) and scope (row, cell, shape). "border" is supported only for shapes.

item.title: v5.5.1
item.description: • [On-Premise] Add the debug option DEBUG=carbone:webserver to see sparse logs of the HTTP body and headers when a report is generated

item.title: v5.5.0
item.description:
• [EE] Added a new :drop/:keep option col to dynamically delete table columns. This beta feature is supported for DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, and HTML templates. Example Carbone tag to place in a table cell: {d.value:ifEM:drop(col)} . This means that if the value is empty, the entire column is deleted. It can be combined with other :drop(row) tags or with multiple :drop(col) tags based on different conditions.
• [EE] The :html formatter supports the full spectrum of HTML entities (previously limited to named entities only): Added full support for decimal © and hexadecimal © numeric entities, with strict XML 1.0 validation. Added Emojis support as literal Unicode characters and numeric HTML entities. Fixed named entities mapping to two code points (e.g. fj , ∩︀ ) now render correctly.
• [EE] Completely reworked the asynchronous rendering system with webhooks to fix race condition issues and speed up processing.
• [EE] Reduce the risk of converter starvation when a template uses appendTemplate . When a template uses this formatter, maxDownloadFileConcurrency is automatically adjusted for this report only, so it is lower than or equal to the number of converter threads.

item.title: v5.4.5
item.description:
• [On-Premise] Fixed Markdown file type detection to enable MD to PDF, MD to DOCX, MD to ODT, ...
• [On-Premise] Added Markdown support in the Studio
• Fixed Swiss QR code ( swissqrcode ) bugs related to accented characters
• Fixes for the :html formatter: Multiple arguments provided to the formatter were not recognised; now fully supported: Custom Heading and/or Table Themes and/or the "nospace" option. If the HTML contained a color as an inline style, it was not recognised when it contained space characters; it is now fully recognised.

item.title: v5.4.4
item.description:
• Add the new optional tag {o.hardRefresh=true} to force a template to be processed by a converter (LibreOffice, etc.) even when the output file type is the same as the input file type. For example, it can be used to update XLSX formulas after Carbone injects the data.
• Add limits maxTemplateUncompressedSize (200 MB by default) for unzipped templates to improve resistance to zip bomb denial-of-service attacks (CVE-2026-18929)
• [EE] Update to Node 22.22.2

item.title: v5.4.3
item.description:
• Add new options that can be used in a template to force some parameters {o.timezone = Europe/Paris} : force the timezone {o.converter = L} : force the converter ( L : LibreOffice, O : OnlyOffice, C : Chrome) {o.lang = en-US} : force the language. Accepts uppercase or lowercase {o.exportFormattedValuesAsText = true} : force formatN to generate numbers as localized text instead of converting them to the XLSX number format. Available only for XLSX templates.
• Fix: after analysis, we noticed that the fix for object iteration introduced in v5.4.2 could break some poorly designed reports. Therefore, this version disables the fix by default. It can be enabled only by adding the pre-release tag {o.preReleaseFeatureIn=5004002} to the template.
• [Studio] Fix: avoid relying on the machine time to set the deployment timestamp
• [API]: POST and PATCH /template now return the deployedAt value saved by the backend. This is useful when the submitted object contains the constant value 42000000000 to set the deployment time to now.
• [Studio] Fix: Studio now automatically deploys a version if all versions of a template have deployedAt = 0 (no deployed template). This can happen if the template was created through the API without setting the deployedAt timestamp.
• [Studio] Fix: remove an unnecessary preview refresh when downloading a file too early, before the file is fully downloaded
• Enable the :appendTemplate formatter for Carbone Cloud

item.title: v5.4.2
item.description:
• Fix: Support direct object access and iteration over the object at the same time: {d.myObj.id} {d.myObj[i].att} {d.myObj[i+1].att}
• Fix: Incorrect output when direct object access is used after iterating over the object at the same time
• Fix: Support :aggSum when the root d is an array with nested loops: {d[].sub[].val:aggSum}
• Fix: Scheduled metadata flush cron now works even when peerEndpoints is defined but no peers are available

item.title: v5.4.1
item.description: • [On-Premise] Fix the template metadata cron when no other peers are used.

item.title: v5.4.0
item.description:
• ð We simplified the vocabulary across the documentation and logs to make Carbone easier to understand: "Stateful VS Stateless" becomes "With / Without template management" "Studio Web Component: embedded versioning vs embedded" becomes "Studio Web Component: With / Without template management" "With / Without versioning" becomes "With / Without template management" "With / Without database" becomes "With / Without template management" The term "Database" is replaced by "Template metadata" For new installations, the default filename stored on disk (or external storage) is metadata.db . Consider it as a special template file, stored like any other template in template storage.
• Renamed databaseName ( CARBONE_DATABASE_NAME ) to templateMetadataFile ( CARBONE_TEMPLATE_METADATA_FILE ). Default value is "metadata.db".
• databaseName ( CARBONE_DATABASE_NAME ) remains supported for backward compatibility and automatically enables templateManagement=true . If both old and new parameters are set, Carbone uses the new parameters in priority
• âï¸ Add a single boolean configuration parameter, templateManagement (or CARBONE_TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT ), to enable the template management. It replaces the old method, which required setting a filename in databaseName (or CARBONE_DATABASE_NAME ).
• â¡ï¸ Adds the final missing features to fully support template management across a cluster of nodes or Docker containers, with high availability and no single point of failure Carbone now regularly flushes template metadata to /template as: .metadata.db.0 = current .metadata.db.1 = previous If template plugin hooks are implemented ( writeTemplate and readTemplate ), these files are also stored on external storage as: .metadata.db.0.backup = current .metadata.db.1.backup = previous Combined with the existing conflict-free synchronization ( peerPort and peerEndpoints ), this allows cluster nodes to start and stop dynamically while staying in sync without data loss… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-4-0)

item.title: v5.3.0
item.description:
• Remove unsupported/outdated conversion format: mediawiki (mediawiki), StarWriter (sdw3, sdw4, vor, vor3, vor4, vor5), AportisDoc (pdb), StarCalc (sdc, sdc3, sdc4), StarDraw (sxd3, sxd5), X PixMap (xpm), StarImpress (sda, sdd, sdd3, sdd4)
• [On-Premise only] Added new import/export formats supported by the latest LibreOffice version: Document: Markdown ( md ), SVG ( svg ), WEBP ( webp ), Apple Pages ( pages ) Spreadsheet: Apple Numbers ( numbers ), Parquet ( parquet ), JSON ( json ) Graphics: WEBP ( webp ), MS Publisher ( pub ), Corel Draw ( cdr ) HTML: JPEG ( jpeg ), JPG ( jpg ), WEBP ( webp ), PNG ( png ) Presentation: WEBP ( webp )
• Make Carbone compatible with LibreOffice v26.2, without losing compatibility with older versions.
• On macOS only, look for an external Python binary in /Applications/libreoffice-python/Resources/python and $HOME/libreoffice-python/Resources/python , because LibreOffice 25.2.4.2+ no longer allows running the embedded Python.
• [EE] Fixed: The :html formatter renders Heading Elements (

) with the default "Heading 1" through "Heading 6" styles in DOCX when no custom theme is specified. Previously, in some cases, headings were rendered with the Normal style.
• [EE] Watermarks improvements: Multiple watermarks can be defined (5 max), each with options for color, position, rotation, size, font, etc. Supports {#PAGE_NUMBER} and {#PAGE_TOTAL} variables for dynamic page numbering in watermarks. Automatic alignment based on the chosen anchor. Both the old Watermark (defaults: centered, 45Â°) and the new Watermarks fields can be used simultaneously. Up to 4 watermarks can be set at the same time. Example usage: { "convertTo" : { "formatName" : "pdf" , "formatOptions" : { // Legacy (backwards compatible): single centered watermark (string) "Watermark" : "Watermark Carbone.io" , // New: array of watermark objects "Watermarks" : [ { "text" : "Confidential Page {#PAGE_NUMBER} / {#PAGE_TOTAL}" , "anchor" :… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-3-0)

item.title: v5.2.0
item.description:
• Fix: the GET /templates/tags and GET /templates/categories endpoints now list only tags and categories from deployed templates (same logic as GET /templates ), sorted by name.
• Studio now automatically detects the base path when Carbone is served behind a reverse proxy under a subpath (for example, https:///sub/path )
• Fix: prevent a possible crash when a PDF form contains an invalid Carbone tag
• Fix: accept parsing of invalid PDF forms
• Array search expressions are now supported in all formatters. Example: :print(d.tables[searchExpression].id) . This feature is enabled only when the pre-release tag {o.preReleaseFeatureIn=5002000} is used. Supported searchExpression forms: Index lookup : [INTEGER] Selects the element at a numeric index. Example: {d[i].movies[i].id:print(..actors[10].name)} Current iterator lookup : [.i] Uses the current loop index. Example: {d.movies[i].id:print(..otherTable[.i].name)} [NEW] Equality lookup : [LEFT_OPERAND = RIGHT_OPERAND] Filters the target array and returns the first matching element. Rules: Only one equality expression is allowed per lookup. LEFT_OPERAND must be relative to the searched array items and must match types (e.g., integer cannot match string ). You can write id or .id (both are accepted). Example: in {d.movies[i].id:print(..actors[id=.actorId].name)} , id refers to a field on objects inside the actors array. Important: if you write something like d.sub.id , d is treated as a field on the searched array item, not an absolute root path. RIGHT_OPERAND can be either: a relative path from the main tag (starting with . ), or an absolute path starting with d. or c. . Example: {d.movies[i].id:print(..actors[id=.actorId].name)} where .actorId comes from the current movies item. If RIGHT_OPERAND does not start with d. , c. , or . , it is treated as a constant string. Limitation: constant strings cannot contain whitespace.
• [EE] HTML Formatter Improvements: New Beta Feature: The :html… (read more: https://carbone.io/changelog.html#v5-2-0)

item.title: v5.1.5
item.description: • Studio: Fix opening templates when all versions have deployedAt = 0 .

item.title: v5.1.4
item.description:
• [EE] HTML Formatter Tables Improvements New Feature: Automatic Table Styling from Template Themes. For DOCX only, injected tables can now automatically inherit styling from existing Table Themes defined in the template. This feature is not supported for ODT templates. The priority order for theme application is: Explicitly passed theme name via the tabletheme argument (e.g., {d.content:html(tabletheme:GridTable2-Accent3)} ). Default theme set for the entire document. Instructions to set a default theme for the entire document: Open your DOCX template > Insert a table and navigate to the "Table Design" tab. > Right-click a theme and select "Set as Default" > "This Document Only". > Delete the temporary table and save the template. > This ensures all injected tables use the default theme unless overridden. Fallback theme: "TableGrid" (used if no other theme is specified). Fixed: DOCX templates now render tables at 100% of the document body width, preventing overflow. Fixed: ODT templates now render tables at 100% of the document body width consistently, resolving issues where complex tables were previously shrunk. Fixed: Column widths in DOCX and ODT templates are now consistent and evenly distributed. Improved: elements in DOCX and ODT templates now render as bold text, aligning with the HTML standard. Note: To enable HTML table rendering, use the pre-release tag: {o.preReleaseFeatureIn=5000009} .
• Accept Watermark with number value instead of string
• Disable tagged PDFs when the Chrome converter is used, to generate smaller and faster PDFs by default.
• Add the boolean option generate-tagged-pdf when converting from HTML to PDF using the Chrome converter ( converter: 'C' ). The default is false . < carbone-pdf-options generate-tagged-pdf = "true" />

item.title: v5.1.3
item.description:
• Update dependencies
• â ï¸ Fix a critical security issue identified in a recent audit

item.title: v5.1.2
item.description:
• In SVG templates, automatically replace ligatures to prevent Carbone tags from breaking. This addresses an issue where Affinity Designer and Adobe Illustrator tend to insert ligatures inside Carbone tags by default.
• Fix the download issue when calling GET /template/templateOrVersionId_sample.json (the second call always returned the template instead of the JSON sample).

item.title: v5.1.1
item.description:
• Embedded Web Component Studio improvements Restored the previous studio.openTemplate(template, options) method from before 5.1.0 for easier migration . This function now displays a deprecation warning (superseded by openTemplateVersionId ). Removed the ambiguous studio.openTemplateWithVersioning API. Added studio.openTemplateId(id) to open a template by its 64-bit ID and automatically load all related versions. Added studio.openTemplateVersionId(versionId, type, defaultTemplateAttributes) to open a template by versionId. In embedded-versioning mode, this will automatically assign a unique 64-bit ID to the template.
• [On-Premise] Fix: In the template list, the Studio does not display the "Free tier" label or the call-to-action button to disable template auto-delete.
